description.subtitle: Puma Spanish La Liga Soccer Ball 2025 2026 Size 5 in Box - White
description.tagline: Feel the spirit of La Liga from the first touch
description.intro: With a design inspired by the 25/26 season, this size 5 ball combines professional aesthetics and functionality. Ideal for those looking to train or play with a look and performance that reflects elite football.
key_benefits: Official edition of La Liga 25/26: Exclusive graphic design with the colors and logos of the championship.
Regulation size: Perfect for matches and training for people over 12 years old.
Alta resistencia al uso intensivo: Fabricado con materiales duraderos pensados para un uso prolongado.
Excellent ball control: Heat-sealed panels and textured surface for a more precise touch.
Includes individual box: Ideal presentation to give as a gift or keep as a collector's item.
